title: Entry into Singapore for Foreign Spouses of Singapore Citizens in Light of COVID-19 Travel Restrictions
what_it_is: Entry into Singapore for Foreign Spouses of Singapore Citizens in Light of COVID-19 Travel Restrictions

sections.label: Long-Term Pass holders return approval
sections.summary: Long-Term Pass holders, including foreign spouses of Singapore Citizens, must get prior approval before returning to Singapore or be denied immigration clearance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: All Long-Term Pass holders are required to seek prior approval before returning to Singapore, so that we can regulate the rate of return to a number which our resources, in particular, healthcare resources, can cope with.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Those who arrive in Singapore without having obtained prior approval will not be allowed to clear immigration and will be asked to fly out of Singapore immediately at their own cost.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Foreign spouses of Singapore Citizens, who are holding Long-Term Passes, are also required to comply with this requirement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: They will be given high priority in the queue.
